name: SK_Dragon_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

rig.rest_pose: standing pose as modelled (not a T pose)
rig.animation: none: skeleton and skin weights only; no clips, no Physics Asset, no control rig
rig.skeleton: bespoke (CONVENTIONS.md section 11: any skeleton with a single root bone named root)

pivot: feet: armature origin on the ground between the feet, front on -Y
dresses: dragon standing upright on its hind legs, 3.4 m at the head with a 6.7 m wingspan: orange-brown scaled hide with a dark back and pale belly plates, long neck, horned head, green veined wing membranes reddening to the trailing edge, long tail, dorsal spines
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: NOT photoreal at 1 m: a lit maquette. Anatomy is a joint-graph blob with displaced belly plates; no modelled musculature, wing-finger joints, eyelids, nostrils or mouth interior (there is a jaw bone but no mouth opening). Wing membranes are 12 mm solid shells stretched between straight spars: opaque in the game material (no translucency map), with no folds when the wing bends. Game mesh is a decimation of the remeshed source (no edge loops at joints). Inverse-distance skin weights, checked in one pose; membranes follow the nearest finger bone and will stretch badly if the wings fold. No animation clips (the dragon of the game flies, breathes fire and dies: none of that is here), no Physics Asset. Scale is a guess from the sprite: 3.4 m at the head, 6.7 m wingspan.
